WITH status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_imgcount
  FROM scanenvironment se
  INNER JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_imgcount) as mean_of_avgs
  FROM status_stats
)
SELECT 
  ss.entrystat,
  ss.avg_temp,
  ss.avg_imgcount,
  ss.avg_imgcount - ga.mean_of_avgs as imgcount_delta
FROM status_stats ss
CROSS JOIN global_avg ga;
